text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today is the Teio Sho, the race that
decides the
dirt champion for the first
half of the year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems Wonder Acute is struggling to
muster
enthusiasm.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After trying all kinds of treatments,
we've
managed to get her nice and
limber again, but
we've made no
progress on the emotional side.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Oi Racecourse. Brings back
memories, huh?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You know what I'm talking about, right?
The
Japan Dirt Derby.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It was the first G1 I ran here, back when
I still had
no idea how difficult Oi
Racecourse was to run
on.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
But that was also when I realized how
strong our
bond is and how much I could
rely on it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The memories come flooding back,
running
through my mind one after the
next.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hm, okay. I guess I will.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The energy in the racecourse has
reached its
peak. Despite that...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unbeknownst to everyone, one person is
silently
sinking down to further depths.
